title: Topic 20 | Law of conservation of momentum

questions.text: The speed of a bus of mass 4 t on a straight section of road increased from 5 m/s to 10 m/s. Find the change in the bus's momentum.
A bullet of mass 6 g flying horizontally at 300 m/s pierces a block of mass 500 g lying on a smooth table and emerges from it at 150 m/s. Determine the speed of the block (m/s).
Two bodies of masses 400 g and 200 g came to rest after a collision. If the speed of the first body before the collision was 0.8 m/s, what was the speed of the second body (m/s)?
A ball of mass 80 g moves toward a stationary ball of mass 40 g. Assuming a central perfectly inelastic collision, find the change in the momentum of the second ball.
Two identical balls of mass 2 kg move toward each other. The speed of one ball is 3 m/s and that of the other is 7 m/s. Find the magnitude of the total momentum of both balls.
A body of mass 1 kg starts uniformly accelerated rectilinear motion from rest with an acceleration of 6 m/s². Determine the change in its momentum over a distance of 3 m (N·s).

A shell of mass 40 kg flying horizontally at 600 m/s explodes into two fragments of 30 kg and 10 kg. The larger fragment continues in the original direction of motion at 900 m/s. Find the magnitude of the velocity of the smaller fragment (m/s).

A body of mass 1 kg moves uniformly along a circle of radius 1 m with an angular velocity of 2 rad/s. Find the magnitude of the change in the body's momentum when the radius vector drawn from the center of the circle to the body turns through 180°.
Two bodies move toward each other. One moves at 3 m/s. After the collision, the first body moves in its original direction at 1.5 m/s. Find the ratio of their masses.
A projectile of mass 10 kg leaves a cannon of mass 900 kg at an angle of 60° to the horizontal at a speed of 200 m/s. What velocity does the gun acquire when fired (m/s)?

A motorcyclist rounds a turn on a banked track. If the coefficient of friction is 0.75 and the track's angle of inclination to the horizontal is 45°, how many times is the maximum possible speed greater than the minimum?

A person standing on ice threw a stone of mass 0.5 kg along the ice. Before stopping, the stone traveled 20 m in 2 s. If the person's mass is 60 kg, at what speed does the person start to move as a result of the throw (m/s)?

A shot is fired from a rifle of mass 5 kg. How many times greater is the recoil speed of the rifle when it is not pressed against the shooter's shoulder than when it is held firmly against the shoulder? The mass of the shooter is 75 kg.

A raft of mass 200 kg floats along the shore at 0.8 m/s. A person of mass 60 kg jumps off it at 5 m/s in a direction perpendicular to the shore. What is the speed of the raft together with the person now (m/s)?

A small ball of mass 100 g sits on the edge of a table 1 m high. A bullet of mass 10 g moving horizontally at 100 m/s hits it and becomes embedded in it. At what distance from the table (m) does the ball land on the ground?

If a person walks from one end to the other of a cart standing on smooth rails, parallel to the rails, by what distance does the cart shift relative to the ground (m)? The person's mass is 60 kg, the cart's mass is 120 kg, and its length is 6 m.
A water jet with a cross-sectional area of 6 cm² strikes a wall at an angle of 60° to the normal and rebounds elastically. If the speed of the jet is 12 m/s, find the force acting on the wall (N).
A projectile leaves a gun at 600 m/s. If the average pressure force of the powder gases is 2700 kN and the projectile moves in the barrel for 0.002 s, determine the mass of the projectile.

A pile driver hammer of mass 1000 kg falls onto an anvil from a height of 1.8 m. The duration of the impact is 0.1 s. The impact is inelastic. Determine the average value of the interaction force between the anvil and the hammer (in kN).

A ball of mass 0.5 kg hits the floor at a speed of 10 m/s directed at 60° to the vertical and bounces off. If the impact lasts 0.1 s, find the average force of interaction between the ball and the floor (N).

A rocket of mass 5 t flying at 6 km/s turns on its jet engine in order to turn. The speed of the gases is 2 km/s and the fuel consumption is 10 kg/s. Along a circle of what radius (in km) does the turn take place?
A water jet strikes a perpendicular vertical wall and flows down. If the cross-sectional area of the jet is 5 cm² and its speed is 8 m/s, find the force with which the jet acts on the wall (N).
